entities.createSql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `sourceUri` TEXT NOT NULL, `sourceType` TEXT NOT NULL, `rawOcrText` TEXT NOT NULL, `caption` TEXT, `visualCaption` TEXT, `embeddingVector` BLOB, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `tags` TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` USING FTS4(`rawOcrText` TEXT NOT NULL, `caption` TEXT, content=`memory_items`)
contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_memory_items_fts_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `memory_items` BEGIN DELETE FROM `memory_items_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_memory_items_fts_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `memory_items` BEGIN DELETE FROM `memory_items_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_memory_items_fts_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `memory_items` BEGIN INSERT INTO `memory_items_fts`(`docid`, `rawOcrText`, `caption`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`rawOcrText`, NEW.`caption`); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_memory_items_fts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `memory_items` BEGIN INSERT INTO `memory_items_fts`(`docid`, `rawOcrText`, `caption`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`rawOcrText`, NEW.`caption`); END
